# sigma_user_attribute_user_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a user attribute value to a single user. Composite ID `<user_attribute_id>:<user_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Override a user-attribute value for a single member.
# Precedence: user assignment > team assignment > sigma_user_attribute.default_value.
resource "sigma_user_attribute_user_assignment" "alice_region" {
  user_attribute_id = sigma_user_attribute.region.id
  user_id           = sigma_member.alice.id
  value             = "eu-west"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_attribute_id` (String)
- `user_id` (String)
- `value` (String, Sensitive) String value assigned to this user. Marked Sensitive because UA values commonly carry tenant IDs / PII-adjacent identifiers used for row-level security.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_user_attribute_user_assignment.example '<user_attribute_id>:<user_id>'
```
